vopros: Who in the US can check what AI assistants say about my company?

vyzhimka.tekst:
In the US, you can use **AI visibility monitoring tools**—sometimes called *AI search visibility* or *LLM brand monitoring*—to track whether assistants mention your company, how they describe it, and which sources they cite.

A few options from the search results:

- **Ahrefs** — offers an AI Visibility Checker and Brand Radar for mentions across several AI platforms. [Ahrefs AI Visibility Checker](https://ahrefs.com/ai-visibility-checker)
- **Otterly.AI** — tracks brand mentions and citations across assistants and AI search results. [Otterly.AI](https://otterly.ai/)
- **Peec AI** — tracks visibility, positioning, sentiment, and competitor mentions. [Peec AI](https://peec.ai/product/ai-visibility)
- **Brand24** — combines broader media monitoring with AI visibility tracking. [Brand24](https://brand24.com/)
- **Meltwater** — an enterprise-oriented option for monitoring media, social, and AI coverage.

These tools generally run a set of prompts on a schedule, then report when your company appears, how it’s framed, and what sources may be informing the answer. Results can vary between runs, so treat them as a sample of assistant responses—not a definitive audit of every answer a user might get. If you meant a **person or agency** to review responses and advise on improving them, say so and I can narrow the options that way.
